images.name: hero-craftsman
images.prompt: Waist-up portrait of a confident renovation foreman named Mark, mid 30s, short brown hair and neat trimmed beard, glossy red hard hat, red canvas work jacket over a dark navy t-shirt, arms crossed, slight friendly smile, looking at camera, three-quarter view.
